purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for the existing full affiliate audit. Evidence only; this does not create a new queue task, UUID, or duplicate application. The current main-branch registry and latest queue state were checked first; none of these five tools has a dedicated application task in latest.json.

entries.commission: Up to 40% recurring commission for 36 months when referring SaaS companies to Reditus
entries.eligibility: Current official page presents the affiliate program as free to join and aimed at people who can refer B2B SaaS companies.
entries.evidence_summary: Reditus' current official affiliate-program page confirms a live self-affiliate program, up to 40% commission for 36 months, a 90-day cookie, last-click attribution, and free signup.

entries.commission: Standard 40% for 12 months; 45% after 15 paid referrals; 50% after 50 paid referrals
entries.payout_terms: $25 payout threshold shown on the current Reditus Joiin marketplace listing; commissions tracked and paid through Reditus
entries.eligibility: Current Reditus listing says the program is auto-accept and does not require being a paying Joiin customer.
entries.evidence_summary: Joiin's current official partner pages confirm an active affiliate route through Reditus. The current Reditus Joiin listing shows auto-accept, 40%-50% 12-month recurring tiers, a 90-day cookie, free signup, and a $25 payout threshold.

entries.commission: 15% of each referred customer's monthly or annual subscription for the first 12 months
entries.payout_terms: No public payout threshold or schedule was stated on the retrieved official page
entries.eligibility: Official page targets AI consultants, digital agencies, tech creators, SaaS reviewers, and other referrers; AgentWorks asks prospective referrers to contact the company to receive a referral link.
entries.evidence_summary: AgentWorks' current official affiliate page confirms a live referral program paying 15% for 12 months with no earnings cap, plus a separate custom partnership path. Exact cookie and payout terms are not publicly stated and are left unknown.

entries.verification_method: Searched the current Airia official domain and documentation for affiliate, referral, commission, ambassador, and public partner-enrollment paths. Current first-party material exposes general Sales & Partnerships contact/demo routes but no public revenue-sharing affiliate/referral program or commission terms.
entries.evidence_summary: No legitimate current public Airia affiliate/referral enrollment path with commission terms was found on official sources in this audit pass. General enterprise partnership contact is not treated as an affiliate program.

entries.commission: 30% on qualifying purchases made through the referral link
entries.payout_terms: Exact cookie duration, attribution rules, minimum payout, payout method, and product eligibility are defined inside the Affiliate Program Operating Agreement in the affiliate portal and were not publicly visible in the retrieved official help pages
entries.eligibility: Official help center says any Omi user, creator, newsletter writer, community owner, influencer, blogger, or anyone with an audience can join; signup is available in-app or at affiliate.omi.me.
entries.evidence_summary: Omi's current official Help Center confirms a live, free referral/affiliate program, signup at affiliate.omi.me, and 30% commission on qualifying purchases. The separate Ambassador program has rank-based perks and should not be confused with the standard affiliate route.
